websites.title: Websites
websites.requestFailed: Request failed. Please try again later.
websites.emptyList: No Zones yet. Click “Add Zone” in the top right to get started.
websites.invalidId: Invalid website ID. Open the details page from the website list.
websites.notFound: Website not found. It may have been deleted or the ID is invalid.
websites.basicInfoDesc: Maintain the Zone’s registrable root domain. After changing the root, confirm that its domains still belong to it.
websites.dangerZoneDesc: Clear all domains under the Zone before deleting it. Deletion cannot be undone.
websites.deleteZoneDesc: Delete {domain}? Domains under it must be unbound from routes first. This cannot be undone.
websites.editorDesc: A Zone accepts only a registrable root domain, such as example.com.
websites.rootInvalid: Enter a root domain without a protocol or wildcard
websites.analyticsUnavailable: Analytics storage is unavailable, so charts may be empty. Confirm that ClickHouse is enabled.
websites.uniqueVisitorsDesc: The top total is de-duplicated across the whole window; the curve is UV per time bucket and buckets cannot be added together
websites.zoneCertsDesc: Certificates are managed in the global certificate library. This list only shows certificates bound to domains in this Zone.
websites.unboundCertHint: {count} domains still have no certificate. Choose one in the Domains tab.
websites.emptyBoundCerts: No bound certificates. Choose a certificate on a domain row, or import/apply one in the certificate library.
websites.noWildcard: Zone domains do not support wildcards
websites.mustBelongToZone: The domain must belong to Zone {root}
websites.quickCreateDesc: After selecting a Zone, enter a subdomain name (such as api), @ (the root), or a full FQDN.

certificates.title: Certificates
certificates.listDesc: Shows certificate validity, remarks, and status. You can view details, edit contents, or delete certificates.
certificates.requestFailed: Request failed. Please try again later.
certificates.emptyList: No certificates yet. Click “Import certificate” or “Apply for certificate” in the top right to get started.
certificates.reapplySubmitted: Certificate {name} updated and is being re-applied...
certificates.applyEditDesc: Change the ACME certificate settings. After saving, the certificate will be re-applied with the new settings.
certificates.applyConvertDesc: Fill in the ACME application details. After a successful application, the current manual certificate is converted in place to an auto-renewable applied certificate.
certificates.applyDesc: Use ACME (Let's Encrypt and others) to automatically apply for and renew certificates, including wildcard domains.
certificates.name: Certificate name
certificates.otherDomainsHint: One domain per line. For a wildcard certificate, also enter the corresponding root domain so it can be issued together.
certificates.remarkPlaceholder: Optional. Record what this certificate is used for.
certificates.autoRenewDesc: When enabled, the certificate is renewed automatically 7 days before it expires.
certificates.dnsServerPlaceholder: Leave empty to use the default authoritative DNS
certificates.skipCnameDesc: Do not follow CNAME records during DNS-01 validation.
certificates.skipDnsDesc: Ask Let's Encrypt to validate directly without a local check.
certificates.editDesc: You can change the certificate name and remark, and re-upload the PEM certificate and private key.
certificates.notFound: Certificate not found. It may have been deleted.
certificates.importDesc: Paste PEM manually or upload certificate files. After import, you can select it immediately in website forms.
certificates.remarkProdPlaceholder: For example: production certificate for the main site
certificates.selectFiles: Select a certificate file and a private key file.
certificates.detailDesc: View certificate metadata, remarks, and the currently saved PEM contents.

dnsAccounts.title: DNS accounts
dnsAccounts.listDesc: Centrally manage DNS provider accounts used for ACME certificate DNS validation.
dnsAccounts.requestFailed: Request failed. Please try again later.
dnsAccounts.emptyList: No DNS accounts yet. Click “Add account” in the top right to get started.
dnsAccounts.createDesc: Centrally manage DNS provider accounts used for ACME certificate DNS validation.
dnsAccounts.tokenPlaceholder: Do not use a Global API Key

origins.title: Origins
origins.subtitle: Centrally maintain origin addresses reused by routes, so bulk address changes need less repeated work.
origins.emptyDesc: Click Add origin in the top right. Later routes can reuse these addresses directly.
origins.missingId: A valid origin ID is missing.
origins.notFound: Origin not found or already deleted.
origins.relatedRoutesDesc: Shows routes that bind this origin as the primary origin.
origins.noRelatedRoutesDesc: This origin is not referenced by any route yet.
origins.editorDesc: Origins are a reusable address directory for routes. Protocol and port are still decided by the route.
origins.name: Origin name

proxyRoutes.title: Route configuration
proxyRoutes.emptyDesc: Create a website first, then open the configuration page to finish HTTPS, cache, and rate limits.
proxyRoutes.noMatchesDesc: Try a different search term, or clear the filter.
proxyRoutes.deleteSiteDesc: Delete website {name}? This deletes all domains and configuration under the site.
proxyRoutes.missingId: A valid route ID is missing.
proxyRoutes.notFoundDesc: Return to the list and try again.
proxyRoutes.requestFailed: Request failed. Please try again later.
proxyRoutes.noPublishNeeded: The current configuration matches the active version. Nothing to publish.
proxyRoutes.publishDesc: This creates a new version from the pending configuration and sets it as active. Nodes will then pull the update.
proxyRoutes.createDesc: Choose bindings from registered Zone domains. After creating the route, you can continue configuring cache, rate limits, and other advanced options.
proxyRoutes.siteIdOptionalDesc: Optional. If left empty, the first domain is used automatically.
proxyRoutes.siteIdStableDesc: Use a stable, readable business identifier. It does not have to match the domain exactly.
proxyRoutes.bindDomainsHint: Select registered domains to bind. Use “Quick add domain” to create an FQDN under a Zone and select it automatically.
proxyRoutes.upstreamUrlsHint: One full URL per line. The first line is the primary origin. In multi-upstream mode, keep the same protocol and do not include a path or query.
proxyRoutes.tunnelForwardHint: Forward requests to the client node connected by this tunnel.
proxyRoutes.pagesProjectHint: Only enabled Pages projects with an active deployment are shown.
proxyRoutes.enableSiteDesc: When disabled, the configuration is kept but not included in publish.
proxyRoutes.createFailed: Create failed. Please try again later.
proxyRoutes.noZoneDomains: No Zone domains available. Add an FQDN in <websites>Website management</websites> first, or use “Quick add domain”.
proxyRoutes.noBindableDomains: No bindable domains (the rest are already bound to other routes). Use “Quick add domain” to create one.
proxyRoutes.domainSettingsDesc: Bind FQDNs already registered in a Zone. Maintain certificates in Zone domain management.
proxyRoutes.redirectNeedsCert: Bind a certificate to the selected domains (in the Zone) before enabling HTTP redirect
proxyRoutes.redirectHttpEnabledHint: When enabled, extra port-80 redirect rules are generated.
proxyRoutes.redirectHttpNeedsCert: At least one selected domain must have a bound certificate before this can be enabled.
proxyRoutes.reverseProxyDesc: Configure the origin strategy and upstream addresses.
proxyRoutes.originHostHint: If left empty, the request hostname $host is passed through by default.
proxyRoutes.customHeadersHint: One per line, in Key: Value format.
proxyRoutes.limitsDesc: Site rate limits. Empty or 0 inherits the global default; -1 turns it off explicitly; greater than 0 is custom.
proxyRoutes.connLimitHint: Empty or 0 inherits the global default; -1 turns it off; greater than 0 is a custom concurrency cap.
proxyRoutes.ipLimitHint: Empty or 0 inherits the global default; -1 turns it off; greater than 0 is a custom per-IP cap.
proxyRoutes.rateLimitHint: Empty or 0 inherits the global default; -1 turns it off; for example 512k or 1m is a custom bandwidth.
proxyRoutes.reqLimitHint: Empty or 0 inherits the global default; -1 turns it off; for example 10r/s or 100r/m is a custom rate.
proxyRoutes.cacheDesc: Configure the site edge cache policy.
proxyRoutes.enableCacheDesc: New sites should use “Standard static assets”.
proxyRoutes.advancedRiskDesc: Personalized HTML may be edge-cached and served to other users if the origin does not declare private / no-store. See the help next to the title for details.
proxyRoutes.cacheHelpIntro: The extension/policy decides whether a response can be cached. Origin headers and Set-Cookie decide whether it is stored. Global OpenResty cache in performance settings must also be enabled.
proxyRoutes.cacheHelpRecommend: New sites should use “Standard static assets” (includes css/js/map/images/fonts/media, excludes HTML/JSON).
proxyRoutes.cacheHelpGeneral: Non-GET is not cached; login cookies do not skip cache on their own; origin private/no-store or a Set-Cookie response is not written to the edge.
proxyRoutes.cacheHelpAllGet: An advanced option, similar to Cache Everything. Personalized pages must be declared private/no-store by the origin, or HTML may be edge-cached and served to other users.
proxyRoutes.cacheHelpCustom: Use suffixes such as jpg/css/js; path prefixes such as /assets; exact paths such as /robots.txt. After saving, republish a configuration version before it takes effect on nodes.
proxyRoutes.cacheHintSuffix: One suffix per line, for example jpg, css, js.
proxyRoutes.cacheHintPrefix: One path prefix per line, for example /assets, /static.
proxyRoutes.cacheHintExact: One exact path per line, for example /robots.txt.
proxyRoutes.cacheHintStatic: Standard static assets use the built-in extension list. No extra rules are needed.
proxyRoutes.cacheHintNone: The current policy does not need extra path rules.
proxyRoutes.cachePlaceholderNone: No extra rules for the current policy
proxyRoutes.authDesc: Configure Basic Auth to block unauthorized access. Configure PoW protection in a WAF rule group.
proxyRoutes.powHint: PoW protection can only be enabled in a WAF rule group and bound to a site.
proxyRoutes.wafDesc: Global rule groups always apply. Here you can add custom rule groups for the current website.
proxyRoutes.selectCustomRulesDesc: Selected rules run in the execution order below.
proxyRoutes.executionOrderDesc: Custom rules run in this order. Drag them or use the up/down buttons to change the order.

sections.domainsDesc: Maintain the site identifier and choose bound domains from a Zone.
sections.limitsDesc: Set connection limits and rate limits (can inherit global defaults).
sections.proxyDesc: Configure the primary origin and upstream addresses.
sections.wafDesc: Bind WAF rule groups and view the policies that apply to this site.
sections.authDesc: Configure basic authentication so visitors must enter a username and password.

validation.enterAtLeastOneUpstream: Enter at least one upstream address
validation.upstreamMustBeHttp: Upstream address must start with http:// or https://: {url}
validation.upstreamMissingHost: Upstream address is missing a hostname: {url}
validation.multiUpstreamNoPath: Multi-upstream mode does not support addresses with a path or query
validation.multiUpstreamSameProtocol: Multiple upstreams for the same site must use the same protocol
validation.invalidLimitRate: Invalid rate-limit format. Use 512k, 1m, a number, or -1 to turn it off
validation.invalidLimitReq: Invalid request-rate format. Use 10r/s, 100r/m, or -1 to turn it off
validation.cacheRuleRequired: The current cache policy needs at least one rule
validation.enterTunnelTarget: Enter an internal service address (for example 127.0.0.1:8080)

responses.title: Response pages
responses.subtitle: Configure origin error pages and offline pages.
responses.forbiddenSettings: Only administrators can access response page settings.
responses.forbiddenPreviewError: Only administrators can preview the error page.
responses.forbiddenPreviewOffline: Only administrators can preview the offline page.
responses.forbiddenEditError: Only administrators can edit the error page HTML.
responses.forbiddenEditOffline: Only administrators can edit the offline page HTML.
responses.policySaved: Trigger policy saved. Publish a version for the configuration to take effect.
responses.triggerPolicyDesc: Configure when the origin error page is enabled and which status codes trigger it.
responses.enableErrorPageDesc: When disabled, the origin or Nginx default error response is passed through.
responses.getOnlyDesc: When enabled, the custom error page is returned only for matching error status codes on GET requests.
responses.statusCodesDesc: Supports a single code (such as 502) or a closed range (such as 500-599).
responses.statusCodesPlaceholder: For example 502 or 500-599, then press Enter
responses.offlinePageDesc: When enabled, a Service Worker is issued to HTTPS websites. If the domain is unreachable, the browser shows this offline page from cache.
responses.offlineSaved: Offline page saved. Publish a version for the configuration to take effect.
responses.enableOfflineDesc: Only takes effect on HTTPS websites.
responses.scopeDesc: Applies only to the selected HTTPS domains. If empty, nothing is injected.
responses.noScopeSelected: No scope domains selected. After saving, nothing is injected into any site.
responses.enableThenSelectScope: Enable the offline fallback before choosing scope domains.
responses.selectScopeDesc: Inject the offline fallback only for selected HTTPS domains. Search, filter, and bulk-select.
responses.noAvailableDomains: No domains available. Register domains in Zone management first.
responses.errorHtmlSaved: Origin error page HTML saved. Publish a version for the configuration to take effect.
responses.offlineHtmlSaved: Offline page HTML saved. Publish a version for the configuration to take effect.
responses.errorRestored: Cleared to use the server built-in default template (save to apply)
responses.offlineRestored: Cleared to use the built-in default template (save to apply)
responses.restoreErrorDesc: This clears the editor. After saving, the server built-in default template is used. This action does not save automatically.
responses.restoreOfflineDesc: This clears the editor. After saving, the built-in default template is used. This action does not save automatically.
